name: El Morell (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with a black eradicated mulberry tree.
history: The official flag of El Morell is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green, with the black mulberry of the arms of 9/10 of the height of the cloth at the centre; approved by the municipal council on 27 March 2025, by the Department of the Presidency on 22 July 2025 and published in the DOGC.
